_about: Public-domain H. A. Ironside (Harry A. Ironside, 1876-1951) for the Word Hoard, printings dated before 1930 only: The Only Two Religions (catalogued 1912), Notes on Esther (catalogued 1921), Notes on Nehemiah, revised (catalogued 1925), Notes on the Minor Prophets (printed January 1928) and A Life Laid Down, a memoir of Fannie M. Arthur, raw Internet Archive OCR. Nearly every scan of his books is a 1940s-1980s Loizeaux printing and is left out; three undated ones wait in _pending. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

ironside-two-religions: The Only Two Religions; and Other Gospel Papers (New York: Loizeaux Brothers; Toronto: Home Friend Office; no year on title page, catalogued 1912)
ironside-esther: Notes on the Book of Esther (New York: Loizeaux Brothers, 1 East 13th Street; no year on title page, catalogued 1921)

ironside-life-laid-down: A Life Laid Down: A Brief Memoir of Fannie M. Arthur (Oakland: Western Book and Tract Co.; New York: Loizeaux Brothers, 1 East 13th Street; no year on title page, catalogue year wrong)
